play.action: four-frame one-shot descent, immediately readable over #10131c. In every 1536x960 slot draw one fully connected golden-white canopy: a solid opaque horizontal light bar from x=100 to x=1436 at y=25, 60-90 pixels thick, physically joined to five shafts centered near x=170, 470, 768, 1066, and 1366. The bar and all five shafts must be one unbroken connected component in each frame; no detached beams or motes. Frame 1 has short shafts, frames 2 and 3 extend and widen them, frame 4 reaches the upper 45% height. Every shaft has a fully opaque warm-white core 50-90 pixels thick with crisp edges. Keep the bottom half empty.

style: bold high-contrast abstract game effect matching the accepted base image; thick fully opaque golden-white light cores with crisp clean edges, restrained soft fringe only outside the opaque cores, no pixel art, no dark outline, no palette reduction
